title: French Housing Prices DVF 2021-2025 (Cleaned)
subtitle: 608k home sales in 5 French departments, cleaned and aggregated to price per m2
description:
# French housing prices 2021–2025 (DVF, cleaned)

Every real estate sale in France is published by the French government in the **DVF** open data (*Demandes de valeurs foncières*). The raw files are notoriously tricky to use. This dataset is the **cleaned output of a data engineering pipeline** (Python ingestion, dbt transformations and 25 data quality tests, orchestrated by Airflow): one row per sale of a single home, with a reliable **price per m²**.

**Coverage:** 2021–2025 · 5 departments: Paris (75), Rhône / Lyon (69), Bouches-du-Rhône / Marseille (13), Gironde / Bordeaux (33), Hérault / Montpellier (34) · 1,298 communes.

## Files

| File | Rows | Content |
|---|---:|---|
| `home_sales.parquet` | 608,226 | One row per sale of a single apartment or house |
| `price_per_m2_by_commune_year.csv` | 9,359 | Median, quartiles of price per m², median price and size, by commune, year and property type |
| `price_per_m2_by_department_month.csv` | 600 | Monthly median price per m² by department and property type |
| `communes.csv` | 1,298 | Commune names, department and coordinates (median of geolocated sales) |

## How the raw data was cleaned

| Pitfall in raw DVF | What goes wrong if ignored | Treatment |
|---|---|---|
| One sale = several rows (home, cellar, parking, land parcels), and the **total price is repeated on every row** | prices multiplied when summed | grouped by sale, price taken once |
| 7 % of sales include **several homes** sold together | the price per home cannot be known | excluded |
| A sale can include parcels in **two communes** | sale assigned to the wrong commune | location taken from the home's own row |
| Outliers (symbolic 1 € sales, parking lots declared as flats…) | distorted averages | kept only 500–30,000 €/m², homes ≥ 9 m²; medians instead of means |

Only *Vente* and *Vente en l'état futur d'achèvement* (new builds, `is_new_build = true`) are kept.

## Columns of `home_sales.parquet`

`sale_id`, `sale_date`, `year`, `month`, `is_new_build`, `department_code`, `commune_code` (INSEE code), `commune_name`, `postal_code`, `property_type` (Apartment / House), `living_area_m2`, `rooms`, `outbuildings` (cellars, parkings sold with the home), `land_area_m2`, `price_eur`, `price_per_m2_eur`, `longitude`, `latitude`.

## Source and license

Source: *Demandes de valeurs foncières géolocalisées*, Etalab / DGFiP, published on data.gouv.fr under the **Licence Ouverte / Open Licence 2.0** (compatible with CC-BY 2.0). This derived dataset is shared under the same license: please credit the original source.

Pipeline code (ingestion, dbt models and tests, Airflow DAG, React dashboard): https://github.com/MKkevin2712/dvf-pipeline

Author: Kevin Moukam Nkameni
